prepared_artifact.split_method: fixed seed 42; route-segment key inferred from source filename; each route segment assigned wholly to one split

visual_review.finding: road surface and pothole outlines correspond in reviewed examples; DNIT watermark visible and retained; binary mask uses black background and white marked regions
visual_review.limits: sample review only; no claim of full semantic accuracy or current/local road coverage

student_use: prototype to highlight marked pothole regions while documenting a road maintenance request; not road safety assessment
attribution: Passos et al. (2020), Cracks and Potholes in Road Images, Mendeley Data v3, CC BY 4.0; reorganized and selected source POTHOLE masks.
